```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r summary, results='asis'}
cat(readLines("summary.md"), sep = "\n")
```

```{r figures, results='asis'}
for (f in list.files("figures", pattern = "png$", full.names = TRUE)) cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n![](%s)\n", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), f))
```
